name: Long-grain rice
definition: slender non-aromatic rice grains that stay separate when cooked.
notes: Shop lists long grain rice separately from basmati and jasmine.

name: Basmati rice
definition: the long, aromatic, aged grain of the basmati group.
notes: Sold as basmati, incl. baby basmati; brands Daawat, India Gate named.

name: Jasmine rice
definition: the long, soft, fragrant grain of the jasmine group.
notes: Sold as jasmine / Thai jasmine; H-E-B page: Thai Hom Mali, aromatic long grain.

name: Medium- and short-grain rice
definition: rounder rice that cooks tender and clings, including sushi and pudding rice and the Indian table rices.
notes: Short grain rice and sushi rice sold; Koshihikari described as short, round, sticky.

name: Risotto rice
definition: rice sold for risotto because it gives up starch as it cooks.
notes: Arborio and Carnaroli sold as Italian rice for risotto.

name: Paella rice
definition: rice sold for paella because it absorbs a lot of stock and stays whole.
notes: Paella rice sold as its own product; Calasparra PDO rice is Bomba type.

name: Glutinous (sticky) rice
definition: rice that turns sticky and translucent when cooked, of any bran colour.
notes: Glutinous / sweet / sticky rice sold under those names.

name: Red and black rice
definition: non-glutinous rice with a red or black bran layer left on.
notes: Black rice and Thai red rice sold; black glutinous also exists (overlaps kind 07).

name: Flattened rice (poha)
definition: rice grains steamed or parboiled and rolled flat.
notes: Poha sold as flattened rice, fine/medium/thick.

name: Millet
definition: small whole millet grains (finger, foxtail, kodo and others).
notes: Hulled millet sold as grain.

name: Quinoa
definition: the seed of the quinoa plant sold as a grain.
notes: Quinoa white and red sold whole as grain.

name: Wild rice
definition: the long dark grain of the aquatic grass Zizania, not a rice plant.
notes: Wild rice sold as its own product; Eden page lists it among whole grains.

name: Tapioca pearls (sabudana)
definition: dried pearls of cassava starch.
notes: Sabudana sold as tapioca pearls.

name: Plain / all-purpose wheat flour
definition: refined soft-wheat flour for general baking and cooking.
notes: Plain flour sold under that name (White Wings, Black & Gold).

name: Bread and pizza wheat flour
definition: stronger wheat flour for yeast doughs.
notes: Bread and pizza flour sold (Lighthouse; strong white bread flour; Caputo 00 pizza).

name: Wholemeal wheat flour
definition: wheat flour milled from the whole grain.
notes: Wholemeal flour sold; type numbers shown as attribute.

name: Rye flour
definition: flour milled from rye.
notes: Rye flour sold by type number (1150, 1350, 997).

name: Spelt flour
definition: flour milled from spelt.
notes: Spelt flour white and wholemeal; Type 630.

name: Whole-wheat atta
definition: finely ground whole-wheat flour for South Asian flatbreads.
notes: Atta / chakki atta whole wheat sold under those names.

name: Semolina (sooji, rava)
definition: coarse granular milled wheat endosperm.
notes: Sooji, rava and semola rimacinata sold as coarse semolina.

name: Chickpea flour (besan)
definition: flour milled from chickpeas.
notes: Besan (chickpea / gram flour) sold.

name: Rice flour
definition: flour milled from rice.
notes: Rice flour white and brown sold.

name: Long-strand pasta
definition: long cut strands of durum pasta, solid or hollow.
notes: Ronzoni filters by shape Long; linguine, spaghetti; tagliatelle nests shelved as long-cut.

name: Tube pasta
definition: short hollow cuts of durum pasta.
notes: Penne rigate, mostaccioli rigati, macarrones listed under Short shapes.

name: Short and twisted pasta
definition: short solid shapes of durum pasta, twisted, shell or bow.
notes: Medium shells sold as short shape.

name: Soup pasta (pastina)
definition: very small shapes of durum pasta for cooking in broth.
notes: Pastina and acini di pepe sold under Soup shape.

name: Egg pasta, ribbons and nests
definition: pasta or noodles made with egg in the dough, cut into ribbons or coiled nests.
notes: Egg noodles and egg tagliatelle nests (eggs 27% on Filotea page) sold.

name: Udon
definition: thick Japanese wheat noodles.
notes: Udon sold dried and fresh; kishimen and inaniwa styles.

name: Somen
definition: very thin Japanese wheat noodles.
notes: Somen sold dried (J-Basket, Shirakiku).

name: Ramen noodles
definition: alkaline wheat noodles, fresh, dried or in an instant brick.
notes: Ramen noodles dried; Hakubaku organic ramen; Tenobe hand-pulled ramen.

name: Soba
definition: Japanese noodles made with buckwheat flour; the buckwheat share is an attribute.
notes: Soba sold incl. 100% buckwheat juwari soba.

name: Glass noodles (harusame)
definition: transparent noodles made from mung bean, potato or a similar pure starch.
notes: Harusame sold; Eden: mung bean starch glass noodle.

name: Potato gnocchi
definition: small unfilled dumplings of potato dough.
notes: Chilled potato gnocchi sold under that name; ingredient detail seen in search only.

name: Red kidney beans (rajma)
definition: the dark red, kidney-shaped Phaseolus bean.
notes: Red kidney beans dried; rajma sold under that name.

name: Small red beans
definition: small red Phaseolus beans.
notes: Small red rajma/kidney beans (Laxmi); Eden lists Small Red Beans.

name: Lima beans
definition: flat, pale lima (butter) beans.
notes: Baby lima beans sold dried (Camellia); stop & shop aisle lists lima beans.

name: Mung beans
definition: small green mung beans, whole or split.
notes: Whole green mung beans sold (moong); Laxmi lists Moong.

name: Black gram (urad)
definition: black gram beans, whole or split.
notes: Whole black urad and split urad dal sold.

name: Lentils (masoor)
definition: lentils of any colour, whole or split.
notes: Masoor red dal and green/brown lentils sold dried.

name: Chickpeas
definition: kabuli or desi chickpeas, dried or tinned.
notes: Dried chick peas; kabuli chana sold.

name: Pigeon peas (toor, arhar)
definition: pigeon peas, whole or split as dal.
notes: Toor dal / arhar dal (pigeon pea) sold.

name: Almonds
definition: almonds in any form.
notes: Almonds sold raw, peeled, sliced, Marcona.

name: Walnuts
definition: walnuts in any form.
notes: Walnuts sold in shell and shelled.

name: Pecans
definition: pecans in any form.
notes: Pecans sold raw.

name: Hazelnuts (filberts)
definition: hazelnuts in any form.
notes: Hazelnuts sold raw, roasted, in shell.

name: Cashews
definition: cashew nuts in any form.
notes: Cashews sold raw, roasted, pieces.

name: Chestnuts
definition: chestnuts, fresh, dried, roasted or peeled.
notes: Roasted peeled organic chestnuts sold in a pack.

name: Desiccated coconut
definition: dried shredded or grated coconut flesh.
notes: Desiccated coconut sold in flake, macaroon cut, medium shred.

name: Coconut milk and cream
definition: the pressed milk or cream of coconut flesh sold in a tin or carton for cooking; a coconut drink is J3.
notes: Chaokoh coconut milk sold in 13.5 oz cans; lite also.

name: Peanuts
definition: peanuts in any form; the Virginia, Runner or Spanish type is an attribute.
notes: Raw shelled Virginia peanuts sold; roasted peanuts also.

name: Hemp seeds
definition: shelled or whole hemp seeds sold as food.
notes: Hulled hemp seeds / hemp hearts sold as food.

name: Mixed nuts
definition: a mix of several nuts in which no one nut makes up half or more of the weight (K-46).
notes: Mixed nuts sold: raw mixed nuts, Planters deluxe mix of five nuts.
